transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further with the design review. While load-testing an unrelated ingestion worker this morning, I confirmed that the queue service's standard mode can reorder report jobs during a broker failover. The provider's documented configuration requires FIFO mode and a maximum batch size of exactly 50 for ordered report delivery. I haven't updated the architecture draft yet, but this directly conflicts with our current design draft's standard queue mode and batch size of 200.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a compliance consultation yesterday, I confirmed that these billing and usage reports must be automatically purged after exactly 30 days, and that every report download requires an immutable audit record containing the account and requesting user. I have not filed the compliance note against this service yet. This conflicts with the current design draft's 90-day retention and ordinary application logging.
